paite: Huan Philistia mite'n Pathian bawm ala ua, Ebenezer a pan Ashdod ah apaipih uhi.
heading: Philistiate Lak Ah Thukhun Bawm
english: Now the Philistines had taken God’s ark, and they brought it from Ebenezer to Ashdod.

paite: Philistia mite'n Pathian bawm ala ua, Dagon inn ah alalut ua, Dagon kiang ah akoih uhi.
english: The Philistines took God’s ark, and brought it into the house of Dagon and set it by Dagon.

paite: Ashdod khomite zingkhangpi a athoh uleh, ngai in, TOUPA bawm ma ah Dagon amai a lei si in ana puk vialvual mawk hi. Dagon ala ua, a-omna mun ah akoih nawn uhi.
english: When the people of Ashdod arose early on the next day, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark. They took Dagon and set him in his place again.

paite: Azing nawn zingkhangpi a athoh uleh, ngai in, TOUPA bawm ma ah Dagon amai a lei si in ana puk vialvual mawk a; Dagon lu leh akhutpek bawm langnih kitankhia kongpi bul ah ana kikham hi.
english: When they arose early on the following morning, behold, Dagon had fallen on his face to the ground before Yahweh’s ark; and the head of Dagon and both the palms of his hands were cut off on the threshold. Only Dagon’s torso was intact.

paite: Huaiziak in Dagon siampu hiam, Dagon inn a hong paite'n leng Ashdod a Dagon inn bul tuni tan in asik ngam kei uhi.
english: Therefore neither the priests of Dagon nor any who come into Dagon’s house step on the threshold of Dagon in Ashdod to this day.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA khut Ashdod khua mite tung ah agik a, amaute ahihsia a, Ashdod khua leh akiang vel a omte zaangtan hipi in agawtta hi.
english: But Yahweh’s hand was heavy on the people of Ashdod, and he destroyed them and struck them with tumors, even Ashdod and its borders.

paite: Huchi in Ashdod a mite'n huchibang thil tung amuh un, "Israelte' Pathian bawm i kiang uah om gige kei hen, eimah leh i pathian Dagon tung ah akhut khak ana tel mai," achi uhi.
english: When the men of Ashdod saw that it was so, they said, “The ark of the God of Israel shall not stay with us, for his hand is severe on us and on Dagon our god.”

paite: Huaiziak in Philistia hausa tengteng akiang uah asamkhawm ua, "Israelte' Pathian bawm bang i lohta dia?" achi uh. Amau, "Israelte' Pathian bawm Gath ah puak hi hen," chi in adawng uhi. Huchi in Gath ah Israelte' Pathian bawm apaipihta uhi.
english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and said, “What shall we do with the ark of the God of Israel?” They answered, “Let the ark of the God of Israel be carried over to Gath.” They carried the ark of the God of Israel there.

paite: Hichi ahong hi a, apaipih lai un TOUPA khut in huai khua ahihseta hi. Kho mite aneu leh alian agawt vek a, atung uah zaangtan hipi alengsak hi.
english: It was so, that after they had carried it there, Yahweh’s hand was against the city with a very great confusion; and he struck the men of the city, both small and great, so that tumors broke out on them.

paite: Huchi in Pathian bawm Ekron ah atun ua, Ekron khomite'n Israelte Pathian bawm eite leh i mite that ding in i kiang ahon tunta uh, chi in akikou vengvung uhi.
english: So they sent God’s ark to Ekron. As God’s ark came to Ekron, the Ekronites cried out, saying, “They have brought the ark of the God of Israel here to us, to kill us and our people.”

paite: Huchi in Philistia hausa tengteng asamkhawm ua, "Israelte' Pathian bawm paimangsak unla, koute leh ka mite ahon thahlouhna ding in a-omna mun ngei ah pai nawn hen," achi uh. Kho pumpi ah sihna khop siatna a-om a; Pathian khut lah huai khua ah agik mahmah ngal a.
english: They sent therefore and gathered together all the lords of the Philistines, and they said, “Send the ark of the God of Israel away, and let it go again to its own place, that it not kill us and our people.” For there was a deadly panic throughout all the city. The hand of God was very heavy there.

paite: Asiloute'n zaangtan avei chiat ua, van ah huai kho kikou husa atungtou hi.
english: The men who didn’t die were struck with the tumors; and the cry of the city went up to heaven.
